sources.title: gte-tiny: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gte-tiny is a sentence embedding model maintained by TaylorAI that maps text into a 384-dimensional dense vector space for tasks like semantic search, clustering, and text similarity. It is a knowledge-distilled version of thenlper/gte-small, reducing model size by roughly half while maintaining comparable performance.
